question: Which ATT&CK techniques does CAPEC-600 (Credential Stuffing) map to, and what mitigations apply to those techniques?

answer.headline: Gathered 2 record(s) from 2 source(s); 1 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: CAPEC-600 (Credential Stuffing) maps to the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1110.004 (Credential Stuffing). The mitigations associated with this technique include Account Use Policies (M1036), Multi-factor Authentication (M1032), User Account Management (M1018), and Password Policies (M1027).

records.name: Credential Stuffing
records.label: AttackPattern
records.description: An adversary tries known username/password combinations against different systems, applications, or services to gain additional authenticated access. Credential Stuffing attacks rely upon the fact that many users leverage the same username/password combination for multiple systems, applications, and services.
